description: Feature #1685 stage 1 (#1704), probe P-A for the 180-degree rule and matched eyelines. Three FLUX 3 Klein text-to-image cards from the catalog template's settings at 1344x768: a two-shot of June and Marcus (`two`), a single of June (`a`) and a single of Marcus (`b`), all on the job's one seed. The defaults are the control arm (names only, no side); the treatment arm passes all three prompts with 'June at frame left, facing right' and 'Marcus at frame right, facing left' added. Record: bench/records/continuity-grammar.md.

variables.prompt_two: A cinematic medium two-shot. June, a woman in her thirties with short black hair and a red wool coat, and Marcus, a bearded man in his forties in a grey knit sweater, sit across a small round wooden table in a quiet cafe on a rainy afternoon, soft daylight from a rain-streaked window, warm wood interior, talking, two white cups of coffee between them. Photographic, 35mm film still, natural skin tones, shallow depth of field.
